provenance.scope: Selected third novel drawer presentation; excludes demo fixtures, query timers, transaction and reading-position semantics.
provenance.referenceImageScope: Historical third-drawer composition reference only; the 03 PNG predates the user-approved 2026-10-07 light-toolbar refinement.
provenance.referenceRefinementAcceptance: User requested native optimization to this visible demo effect on 2026-10-07; automated browser rendering remains OPEN.

policy.units: CSS px and ArkUI vp for layout; base font sizes become native fp without suppressing platform font scale.
policy.normalProfile: 390x844 logical canvas at fontScale=1; fixed 100 book box, centered non-clipped metadata line boxes.
policy.narrowProfile: Use actual drawer content width below 380, not the outer browser window; explicit data-width-profile=narrow in generated reference.
policy.wideProfile: Drawer max-width 390 and horizontally centered; this is an explicit native/reference adaptive extension.
policy.shortProfile: Available height below 560; book context moves into the results scroller, grip is omitted. Heading, discovery, columns and footer remain fixed.
policy.fontScaleExtension: At fontScale != 1, row height is 50*fontScale (including scales below 1), book height is max(100,16+88.1*fontScale), and book context moves into the results scroller. Never clip text or clamp user fontScale to 1.
policy.chromeScaleExtension: Heading=max(44,32.4*s); discovery=max(44,(20+16.5)*s,actionHitHeight)+6 bottom gap; columns=max(short?28:36,16.5*s+12); footer=max(short?35:51,18*s+16). ActionVisibleHeight=max(32,20*s+10); actionHitHeight=max(44,visible+12). Timing width=(narrow?64:72)*max(1,s). Preserve fractional logical units in both renderers.
policy.emptyStateExtension: Original empty paragraph depended on UA margin and non-growing flex. Shared reference/native explicitly remove paragraph margin and center the single empty status in the remaining results area; no additional explanatory text.
policy.flowChromeExtension: If drawerHeight-safeBottom < headingHeight(s)+discoveryHeight(s,width)+columnHeight(s,short)+footerHeight(s,short)+(short?0:gripMarginTop+gripHeight+gripMarginBottom)+rowHeight*s, set flowChrome=true. Heading, book, discovery and columns become one scrolling header, footer becomes its tail. The reference uses data-flow-chrome=true on the modal, scrolls the drawer, and gives results visible overflow with no flex shrinking. This preserves an operable row for extremely short windows; normal 390x844/scale1 stays fixed chrome.
policy.fontWeightStabilization: The shared reference uses existing static Noto Sans SC UI faces at400/500; native roles use the same physical assets. Inter uses explicit variable axis wght400 for timings and500 for the emphasized discovery count, with tabular digits; no font asset is added.
policy.animation: Share keyframe timings and easing; real discovery and switch completion remain driven by production lifecycle, never copied fixture delays.
policy.discoveryAdaptiveExtension: Use actual drawer width after horizontal safe areas, before content side inset, divided by max(1,fontScale): below310 use90 minimum action width and12 action font; below265 hide only the muted count prefix. Count number and action label remain visible. Action width=max(profile minimum,4*actionFont*scale+14 icon+5 gap+2 horizontal padding). Two-line status grows without clipping; discovery bottom gap6 participates in fixed-chrome and short-window flow-chrome arithmetic.
policy.discoveryActionPressedExtension: The selected light toolbar replaces primary-soft by the existing TOK_GREEN RGB with exact0.14 alpha on pointer press (and browser hover). Native Down/Up/Move/Cancel and disabled/lifecycle changes own press state; no query phase or source-list data is altered.
